fields.name: LoggedIn
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1B1A840 (user-event case 1, the login result; Toolkit OnLoggedIn(Result<void>)): writes the event's success byte to +0 and sets +1; on success also assigns a STDString from LarianNetAPIManager to the optional at +8. bg3.exe+0x1B1A3A0 (~ProcessUserEvents) clears +1 each frame.

fields.name: HasLoggedIn
fields.evidence: has-value flag of the optional bool at +0 (set by bg3.exe+0x1B1A840, cleared by bg3.exe+0x1B1A3A0)

fields.name: LoggingInfo
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1B1A840 assigns a STDString to +8 (FUN_14118fb90, optional assign); bg3.exe+0x1B1A3A0 destroys it as a 24-byte STDString (buffer +8, size +0x18, capacity +0x1C) and clears +0x20

fields.name: HasLoggingInfo
fields.evidence: has-value flag of the optional STDString at +8 (bg3.exe+0x1B1A3A0 tests and clears +0x20)

fields.name: CommunityPlatformConnected
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1B1A3A0 user-event case 0 (Toolkit OnCommunityPlatformConnected(EPlatform)): copies the event byte to +0x28 and sets +0x29 when it changed

fields.name: HasCommunityPlatformConnected
fields.evidence: has-value flag, set in case 0 and cleared by bg3.exe+0x1B1A3A0

fields.name: Errors
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1B1A3A0 case 2 (Toolkit OnError(char const*)): FUN_140E90A70(+0x30, string) appends with stride 0x18 and STDString copy; cleared each frame by FUN_140E907E0(+0x30)

fields.name: PlatformConnections
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1B1A3A0 case 3 (Toolkit OnPlatformConnected/Disconnected(Result<EPlatform>)): FUN_140CB11A0(+0x40, key) is a HashSet insert with 1-byte keys (hash = key byte % buckets, keys compared as bytes, key array at +0x60); the value byte (event +10) goes into the byte array at +0x70 (capacity +0x78, element stride 1). Clear: memset buckets (+0x40, count +0x48) to 0xFF, zero +0x5C and +0x6C. Ends at 0x80 = size.

open_questions: lsnet::EPlatform values (keys of PlatformConnections) are not enumerated; names are inferred from the Toolkit's TrackingSystem methods
second_pass: Every offset and width read from the Windows per-frame code: bg3.exe+0x1B1A3A0 (ProcessUserEvents, all five event kinds and the per-frame reset) and bg3.exe+0x1B1A840 (login result); the platform map turned out to have 1-byte keys (bg3.exe+0xCB11A0 hash insert), not 4-byte.
live_reason: only empty (all-zero) instances were seen: the member boundaries are untested
